title: Clinic booking service: calendar errors that skip the translation layer
name: Clinic appointment booking

questions.prompt: Support tickets from the patient app: when a popular physio slot opens, some patients get 'Something went wrong' (HTTP 500) instead of 'That time was just taken, please pick another', and patients who opted into the waitlist aren't added to it. During last week's calendar outage, some booking attempts also returned 500 instead of 503 with Retry-After, so the app didn't retry. Fix scheduling/service.ts so the tests pass.
